comments.author: @NovaTerrain-4K
comments.text: It's mind-blowing how this vast, sparsely populated steppe was once the beating heart of an empire that ruled most of the world. Do you think the nomadic philosophy of 'leaving no trace on the land' is why they seamlessly returned to their traditional way of life rather than building massive stone cities?

replies.author: @WhereonEarth4K
replies.text: That's a compelling read on it - choosing not to build permanent monuments may say as much about values as capability ever could.
